name: fix-pets-merchant
about: mods/pets: the feeding bowl's functions (pet skills, feeding, pickup toggles) live at the Pet Shop keeper now (class swap PetsShopContent -> HWPPetShopContent). Without a pet the keeper opens the vanilla shop; the bot buys a pet there. With a pet the keeper asks Buy a pet / Train your pet (the pet's status on the window); Train opens the progression menu (gui/hwp_pets.gui: the 7 skill rows, feed section, pickup toggles) and logs `[HWP:pets] pet shop: train`. The lab town has no Pet Shop house, so the keeper is spawned beside the player.

steps.name: keeper: buy, then the Buy/Train choice, then the training menu
